summary: Victory Capital Holdings filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on October 13, 2026, furnishing a press release on monthly and quarterly client assets as of September 30, 2026. Total AUM was $351.9 billion, other assets $3.6 billion, and total client assets $355.5 billion. Third-quarter long-term net inflows were $11.7 billion, with average total AUM of $355.4 billion. The filing also noted an earnings call scheduled for November 5. It contains no transaction, no special-situation event, and no deal terms.
